people.joel.role: Prophet who calls the people to gather in a crop disaster
people.joel.meaning: Joel speaks to the elders and all who live in the land. He tells them to mourn the lost crops. He tells the priests to fast and to gather the people at the LORD’s house. He speaks the LORD’s promise of grain, new wine, and oil. He also speaks the charges against Tyre, Sidon, Egypt, and Edom.
places.jerusalem.summary: The LORD names Jerusalem in chapters 2 and 3. He says some will escape on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem. He says he will roar from Jerusalem. He promises that Jerusalem will be holy and full of people.
places.jerusalem.limits: The marker shows the city. The text gives no exact spot for the valley of Jehoshaphat.
places.tyre.summary: In chapter 3 the LORD speaks to Tyre, Sidon, and Philistia. He says they took his silver and gold into their temples. He says they sold the children of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks.
places.tyre.limits: The marker shows the city or its nearby region. The text gives no exact spot.
places.sidon.summary: In chapter 3 the LORD speaks to Sidon together with Tyre and Philistia. He charges them with selling the children of Judah and Jerusalem. He says he will return the payment on their heads.
places.sidon.limits: The marker shows the city or its nearby region. The text gives no exact spot.
places.egypt.summary: At the end of chapter 3 the LORD says Egypt will become a desolation. He gives the reason: violence done to the children of Judah.
places.egypt.limits: The marker shows the whole land of Egypt, not one site.
places.edom.summary: At the end of chapter 3 the LORD says Edom will become a desolate wilderness. He gives the reason: Edom shed innocent blood in Judah’s land.
places.edom.limits: The marker shows the broad land of Edom, not one site.
sources.web.limits: This edition has three chapters. It gives no exact date for the disaster and no modern fulfillment.
sources.howard-joel-2.limits: The commentary interprets the locust disaster and the selected passage. It gives no certain date.
chapters.1.mapNote: The chapter names no place for the crop disaster.
chapters.2.mapNote: Markers show named places from the speeches. They do not show a route.
chapters.3.mapNote: Markers show named places from the speeches. They do not show a route.
chapters.*.routeEvidence: The army and the gathering of nations are pictured in speech. The text gives no route.
